hero.title: Podiatry in Vaasa - Healthy Feet
hero.subtitle: Whether you have bunions, hammer toes, ball or heel pain, skin or nail problems, or simply want to promote your foot health - welcome to the foot therapist's office!

about.title: Ilojaloin & me
about.paragraph1: I am Satu Paunonen, a podiatrist and entrepreneur from Vaasa – and a mother of four children. Exercise, creativity, and family keep me balanced, and working with people is close to my heart. By nature, I am calm, friendly, and fundamentally positive. I'm curious and enthusiastic about learning new things. I love developing my professional skills and appreciate that podiatry is a field where you never stop learning – there's always something new to discover.
about.paragraph2: I became a podiatrist through my own experiences. I've suffered from flat feet and various foot problems since childhood. Through these experiences, I realized how important feet are for overall well-being. I wanted to learn how I could help myself – and others – feel better.
about.paragraph3: I graduated as a podiatrist in 2015 from Mikkeli University of Applied Sciences and have since worked at Vaasa Central Hospital's internal medicine outpatient clinic. In my work, I've specialized in wound care, podiatry for diabetic and rheumatic patients, and treatment of various pain conditions and structural problems. Thanks to this experience, you can sit in my treatment chair with complete confidence – I've seen all kinds of feet.
about.paragraph4: Entrepreneurship has been on my mind for a long time – the freedom to work according to my own values, creatively and with a people-centered approach. Ilojaloin was born from my desire to help people feel better and promote foot health in a broad, preventive way. I want every visit to be a step towards a lighter, pain-free everyday life.

footTherapy.title: Podiatry
footTherapy.paragraph1: Becoming a podiatrist requires healthcare education spanning 3.5 years. The curriculum includes anatomy, physiology, and biomechanics. This enables me to understand how feet function, why problems develop, and how to prevent and treat them. I'm qualified to treat people with diabetes, rheumatism, circulation issues, and other special conditions.
footTherapy.paragraph2: Podiatry is preventive care that promotes mobility and quality of life. Regular foot, nail, and skin care prevents problems before they become serious. My goal is for every visit to bring relief, and in the long run, keep you on your feet.

services.title: Services
services.intro: At Ilojaloin, I offer comprehensive podiatry services, such as:
items: 🦶 Examinations and foot analyses – assessment of foot health and potential problem areas
💅 Nail correction treatments & nail prosthetics – corrective and protective nail care
💅 Nail trimming & thinning – even challenging nails can be treated
🦶 Help with nail fungus or athlete's foot
🩰 Quick insoles and custom toe orthotics from silicone
👟 Shoe counseling – checking shoe fit, recommending suitable models or features, and the possibility to order quality barefoot shoes through me
🛍️ Quality home care products – for home care and maintaining foot health
❤️ Podiatry for special groups – diabetes, rheumatism, psoriasis, etc.
services.outro: Each treatment is planned according to the client's needs and carried out without rush, with warmth and professionalism. You can also come for podiatry without a specific problem or pain condition. Prevention is also important. By knowing your feet, you can care for them properly and avoid potential future problems. Foot health can always be improved, and it affects overall well-being!

hygiene.title: Safety and Hygiene
hygiene.paragraph1: I have the highest quality and safest equipment on the market. My treatment chair is stable, sturdy, and lifts up to 250 kilograms. It lowers down, making it easy to get on.
hygiene.paragraph2: When grinding skin and nails, I use a water drill that cools and binds dust – the skin doesn't heat up and grinding dust doesn't fly around in the air. This way, both you and I breathe clean air.
hygiene.paragraph4: All my instruments are carefully maintained with new, professional instrument maintenance equipment. The instruments are disinfected, washed, dried, and maintained. They are then sterilized in an autoclave and stored in a closed box. The instrument cabinet is always handled with clean hands.
hygiene.paragraph5: The premises are cleaned after each customer with effective agents that destroy bacteria, viruses, and fungi.
hygiene.paragraph6: Your safety and well-being are most important to me.
hygiene.paragraph7: I take equally careful care of the security of your customer data. I use the Vello patient data system, which is data-secure and Kanta-compatible, so your information remains protected and confidential.

pricingInfo.title: About Pricing
pricingInfo.question: Why are my practice prices at this level?
pricingInfo.paragraph1: I am a university-educated lower limb specialist, and my pricing is based on expertise, responsibility, and how I meet each client.
pricingInfo.paragraph2: At the practice, I am 100% present for you. I don't answer phone calls or handle other matters during the appointment, but focus entirely on caring for your feet and lower limbs. I work efficiently but without rushing – this way your time is used optimally and we often accomplish a lot even in a shorter appointment.
pricingInfo.paragraph3: I always ask about your wishes and needs: what you particularly want treated and how you want to prioritize the time. Treatment is planned together with you.
pricingInfo.paragraph4: After the appointment, I take care of thorough cleaning and instrument maintenance, so that every client receives a safe and hygienic treatment environment. As a healthcare professional, I am bound by confidentiality and documentation obligations, and your appointment information is recorded in the Kanta system. This work happens outside of appointment time and is part of the whole.
pricingInfo.paragraph5: Additionally, as an entrepreneur, I am responsible for systems, instrument maintenance equipment, cleaning supplies, and other business expenses.
pricingInfo.paragraph6: My pricing primarily reflects that you receive expert, calm, and personalized care where your well-being is at the center.

wart.title: Warts
wart.paragraph1: Warts are harmless skin growths caused by the human papillomavirus (HPV). They are very common and can occur at any age.
wart.paragraph2: Not all warts necessarily need to be treated. Often it is possible to allow the body to form the necessary antibodies, whereby the wart will disappear on its own over time.
wart.paragraph3: However, the wart is often located in a pressure area – for example on the sole of the foot – which can cause pain when walking. In such situations, treatment is justified to accelerate the disappearance of the wart and relieve pain.

wartTreatment.title: Wart Treatment
wartTreatment.paragraph1: I have two different treatment methods available for wart treatment. Both are professional products and intended only for professional use:
wartTreatment.method2: Wart freezing treatment (more effective than pharmacy self-treatment methods)
wartTreatment.paragraph2: Both treatments initially include mechanical removal of wart tissue, which improves the treatment's effectiveness and outcome.
wartTreatment.paragraph3: There is not always one single immediately effective treatment for warts. Often several treatment sessions and visits to the clinic are needed. Sometimes the end result may be that a small part of the wart remains, but the majority can be removed and the pain is significantly relieved.

freezingTreatment.title: Wart Freezing Treatment
freezingTreatment.paragraph1: I use professional freezing equipment that produces liquid nitrogen up to –89 °C. During freezing, wart cells are destroyed with the help of cold. After treatment, the skin begins to heal itself from the bottom, and usually within a couple of weeks the wart peels off and is replaced by healthy skin.
freezingTreatment.paragraph2: If it is a large or stubborn wart, multiple freezing treatments may be needed.
freezingTreatment.paragraph3: Freezing can feel temporarily painful. Children have the option to use a numbing Emla patch before treatment, which eases the sensations during treatment.
